digest.component_or_area: file impact state model and CLI
propositions: Empty file_impact value conflates 'author forgot to declare' with 'ticket has no file impact', requiring consumers to adopt conservative interpretation; the system needs an explicit third state to distinguish undeclared from declared-none

Reducer state must gain file_impact_scope (default 'undeclared') and no_file_impact_reason (default ''), with derivation logic: non-empty file_impact → 'paths', empty file_impact + payload scope 'none' → 'none', otherwise → 'undeclared'

CLI command set-file-impact must migrate from fixed-arity _REGISTRY to variadic _ARGV_REGISTRY and support two mutually exclusive forms: array syntax (existing) and --none flag with reason (new), validating that reason contains at least 10 non-whitespace characters
Library function get_file_impact_scope and MCP tool declare_no_file_impact must expose the tri-state as {kind, reason, paths}, applying identical reason validation as the CLI
